resources.string: MyWallet is a manual wallet for recording accounts and transactions. Your records are stored on this device for offline use. Device backup settings may also apply.
When you export a backup or a Tracking CSV, you choose where to save the copy. Keep it somewhere you trust.
The accounts and transactions you enter are stored in this app on your device. Android backup settings may also apply to app data.
Settings can export a wallet backup, and Tracking can export a CSV report. You choose where to save each copy. The destination you choose controls the exported file.
Restore reads the backup file you select and replaces the current wallet data. Choose a file you trust.
Install the app, choose a base currency, then add your first account. You can use the wallet offline.
In Settings, export a backup to a destination you choose. Keep a copy somewhere safe. Restore replaces the current wallet with the selected backup; check the file before confirming.

Report a problem in this project\'s GitHub Issues at https://github.com/aristonis/MyWallet/issues or email aristonis@outlook.com. Include the installed version shown in About, steps to reproduce the issue, what happened, and what you expected. Do not post wallet backups or screenshots with personal financial details in a public issue.
